additionalAbilities.description:
When Patchouli uses her Magic Action she can combine two different elements to create a spell that alters her basic spell with a range of touch (you can touch an empty space in front of you) that deals 2d10 damage.
Fire - 120ft by 5ft in front of you.
Water - Heals allies instead
Wood - Doubles the damage roll
Metal - becomes a line 5ft by 25ft wide centered to the space she touches.
Earth - Ignores resistance

She can use the Water element equal to her Proficiency Bonus

Water: 3 uses per long rest. Spell attack bonus +8; spell save DC 16. For competing areas, Patchouli chooses which applies; Wood multiplies healing as well as damage.
additionalAbilities.name: Fire Water Wood Metal Earth Sign "Philosopher's Stone"

additionalAbilities.description:
Patchouli's damage spells can be changed to any of: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Thunder, or Radiant at will. 
Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells.
additionalAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery

additionalAbilities.description:
When Patchouli uses her Magic action, she can infuse one of its selected elements with Sun or Moon, replacing that element?s normal effect. Five uses per long rest; at most one infusion per turn.
Sun Fire: a freely directed 120-foot by 5-foot line; cannot hit a target twice. Sun Water: heal allies and grant temporary hit points equal to HP actually restored. Sun Wood: triple the base roll. Sun Metal: a 15-foot square centered on Patchouli. Sun Earth: on a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, the enemy becomes vulnerable to the chosen damage type until the end of Patchouli?s turn, including the current damage.
Moon Fire: teleport to a visible space within 60 feet after casting. Moon Water: on a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, enemies have speed 0 and are Prone. Moon Wood: on a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, enemies gain two levels of Exhaustion. Moon Metal: on a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, enemies are Stunned. These harmful Moon effects end at the end of Patchouli?s turn. Moon Earth: immunity to the next damage Patchouli receives.
additionalAbilities.name: Sun Moon Sign "Royal Diamond Ring"

reactions.description:
If Patchouli gets hit with an elemental damage. She can use her reaction to absorb that element in the next spell she creates (Cannot absorb more than 1). She can use this reaction a number of times equal to her Proficiency Bonus
Fire - Adds Fire 
Cold - Adds Water
Radiant - Adds Wood
Lightning - Adds Metal
Thunder - Adds Earth

3 uses per long rest. Absorption does not reduce damage. The absorbed element is added as a third element to the next spell; it expires at the end of Patchouli’s next turn.
